# Demo flows conversation
Date: 2026-09-17 | Duration: 42.790000915527344m

## Summary
The discussion refined a persona-based demo flow in which an engineer creates a feature flag, a data scientist attaches and monitors an experiment, and an experiment leader reviews the program. The demo should begin with the GrowthBook AI Assistant and an experiments overview, using a live story rather than starting from a cloud desktop. The engineer section should show a basic flag in the app, a complex flag in Cursor or a Claude Code terminal, then targeted delivery and ramp scheduling in the app. Data scientist content should combine experiment health checks, shared metrics, templates, warehouse-native metric definitions, and guardrails. Slack notifications were proposed for experiment status or metric drops. For shipping, the PM moves the flag to 100%, while the engineer cleans up feature flags, potentially using an auto-cleanup skill. The leader persona should focus on ROI, experimentation culture, and program value. The tagline remains undecided, and a video-first prototype will be recorded to validate flow and timing with stakeholders.

## Keywords
feature flags, experimentation, demo flow, ROI, data scientist, GrowthBook app
